'''Horst Strage''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] serving in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:ChimaeraCCG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|The [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].]]

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Admiral Strage was assigned to the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] as third in command of [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], the fleet defending the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star]].<ref name="EGW" />

Horst Strage was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by an [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] shot during the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], making his [[Executive officer/Legends|First Officer]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Gilad Pellaeon]], the new [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]] of the ''Chimaera'' and of all the fleet after the destruction of the [[Command ship/Legends|command ships]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']] and the [[Pride of Tarlandia/Legends|''Pride of Tarlandia'']].<ref name="EGW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Horst Strage was first mentioned as "''Chimaera''{{'s}} former captain" in ''[[Heir to the Empire]]''.
